title: introduce-invocation-affine-cost-mapper-and-log-cohorter
author: Samuel Park
description:
Motivation: We need a more robust way to attribute per-invocation cost and latency to high-level causes for SLO triage without exploding cardinality in metrics or tracing. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: 1) an Invocation Affine Cost Mapper (IACM) that maps token/phase-level cost and latency into compact, continuous attribution buckets using an affine transform + learned offset per-model-stage; and 2) a Log Cohorter that groups invocation logs into small cohorts based on lightweight fingerprints (prompt-shape, route, kv-cache-hit pattern) so debugging traces/alerts can surface representative log excerpts rather than noisy full streams.

Summary of changes (single-line format for docs consumption): Adds IACM service, cohorter worker, dashboard panels, alert calibration helper, and e2e test harness for cohort sampling.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc: Linear ENG-17429 (link included in ticket)
- [x] Unit tests for mapper and cohorter
- [x] Integration test: synthetic invocation replay through telemetry pipeline
- [x] Dashboard and runbook snippets
- [x] Backwards-compatible (adds new metrics/labels only)

What IACM does: The mapper ingests per-token phase metrics (kernel-latency, queued-time, decoding-time, kv-cache-status, gpu-queue-depth) and applies a cheap 2-param affine transform per-phase to produce a continuous cost attribution score in [0,1]. Scores are emitted as a new series invocation.affine_cost_score with low-cardinality labels (model_family, route_group, phase). This compresses signal for downstream rollups and enables percentile attribution without adding token-level high-cardinality labels.

What Log Cohorter does: A background worker consumes sampled logs and generates cohort ids using a small fingerprint (hashed prompt-shape, top-2 token-types, kv-hit-runlength). Cohort ids are attached to traces (span tag cohort_id) and to compact log excerpts stored in the telemetry-compact-bucket for quick slices. The cohorter supports deterministic sampling seed for reproducible debugging and an API that returns the top N representative logs per cohort.

Dashboard and alerts: Adds a new dashboard 'Invocation Affinity Matrix' with panels:
- Affine cost score distribution by route_group and phase (ECDF + heatmap)
- Cohort prevalence sparkline and representative log excerpts panel
- Alert calibration helper that suggests adjusted SLO thresholds based on cohort-weighted percentiles (linked to Linear ENG-17454).

Compat and rollout: Feature-flagged via feature.observability.iacm and feature.observability.cohorter. Default is off for existing tenants; flag rollout plan in runbook. New metric names prefixed with invocation.affine_* and telemetry.cohort_* to avoid collisions.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: extra CPU on telemetry ingest path for cohorting. Mitigation: cohorter is asynchronous and uses bounded workers; tests show <5% CPU increase at peak with default sampling.
- Risk: misleading attribution if a model has unusual phase timing. Mitigation: mapper exposes calibration endpoint to tune affine offsets per-model-stage, and we ship a quick calibration job (included).

Related work: This complements the existing token-cost-attribution and span-synthesis efforts but targets compact continuous attribution and representative log sampling rather than per-token histograms (see ENG-17201 and ENG-17110 for prior attempts).

Notes for reviewers: The majority of changes are in telemetry/services/iacm/* and telemetry/cohorter/*. The dashboard JSON is included under observability/dashboards/invocation-affinity-matrix.json. The cohort storage uses the existing compact log bucket; no new storage class required.

Runbook excerpt (short): If invocation.affine_cost_score spikes for a route: 1) open Invocation Affinity Matrix and inspect top cohorts; 2) run calibration endpoint for affected model-stage; 3) if cohort logs show degraded prompts, escalate to solutions-eng with cohort id.
commits_summary: Initial mapper scaffolding; add affine transform math + serialization; cohorter worker and sampling logic; integration harness for synthetic replay; dashboard JSON + runbook; unit tests and CI fixes
review_comments: Maya Chen: Can we bound the emitted metric cardinality further by folding route->route_group? Consider route_group already present in code; otherwise lgtm.
Diego Alvarez: Integration test flaked once on CI (timeout during replay). Suggest adding a retry/backoff in the harness. Fixed in last commit.
Priya Natarajan: Small nit: rename telemetry.cohort_top_logs -> telemetry.cohort_examples for clarity. Author updated variable in worker.py to match.
author_responses: Thanks - folded routes into route_group in mapper config (see config.yaml).
Added backoff and increased test timeout; added comment on determinism for sampling seed.
Renamed metric as requested and updated dashboard panel queries.
ci_summary: CI: lint ✅, unit tests ✅, integration replay ✅ (after rerun). Performance bench: no regression on p50/p90; p99 reduced by ~1.8% on our synthetic mix.
release_notes: Adds Invocation Affine Cost Mapper (invocation.affine_cost_score) and Log Cohorter (telemetry.cohort_*). Instrumentation is feature-gated; consult runbook for rollout instructions.
merge_outcome: Merged by Maya Chen after two approvals; squash-merged to main. See merged_at.
notes_for_ops: Feature flags default off. To enable for a tenant: set feature.observability.iacm=true and feature.observability.cohorter=true in tenant config. Calibration script available at telemetry/services/iacm/calibrate.py.
observability_impact: Low-cardinality continuous score reduces downstream metric explosion while preserving percentile attribution; cohorter provides representative log excerpts to speed SLO RCAs.
qa_steps: 1) Enable flags on staging tenant; 2) Run synthetic-replay with sample prompts; 3) Verify invocation.affine_cost_score emitted; 4) Open dashboard and confirm cohorts show representative logs; 5) Run calibration job and verify score shifts for affected model-stage.
